disposition_reason: Tables 3, 4, 6 and 7 print single-can Al, Fe, Pb, Cr, Ni and Sn in canned tuna, sardines and tomato concentrate before and after aging, and Al in tuna cooked with aluminium.

study.design: Laboratory storage and cooking study of canned foods (single cans)
study.period_text: tomato cans produced 2011 and 1 May 2016; analysis dates not reported
study.method: 1 M HCl extraction at 80 C for 1 h, 0.45 µm filtration; AAS; can steel by XRF and foil/tray by EDS
study.qa: blank test only; AFAK CONTROL laboratory guidance (ISO 17025 lab)

findings.material_label: Canned tuna crumbs in tomato sauce
findings.group: recently canned tuna ("fresh tuna"), not aged
findings.notes: Single can per condition; 5-10 g extracted with 1 M HCl at 80 C for 1 h (not a total digestion), filtered, flame AAS. No LOD, CRM or recovery reported. Basis as sold (can contents). Magnitudes (e.g. Fe below 0.3 mg/kg) are far below usual levels for these foods, consistent with a partial acid leach or a unit problem; treat with caution.

findings.notes: Single can per condition; 5-10 g extracted with 1 M HCl at 80 C for 1 h (not a total digestion), filtered, flame AAS. No LOD, CRM or recovery reported.
